_comment: Registry for the Pokémon Evolved Hub (apps/hub).
Each entry becomes one tab in the generated index.html.
Adding a future generation is a data edit here — no code change needed.
Regenerate the page with: python3 apps/hub/build_hub.py

apps.title: Generation 1 — Red / Blue / Yellow
apps.summary: A native LÖVE2D recreation of Pokémon Red, Blue and Yellow. The engine and map behaviour are hand-written Lua; game data and graphics are decoded from a ROM you supply. This is the one you can play outright today — no emulator, no ROM patching.

rom.note: Only the canonical 1 MiB US ROMs are accepted. The importer verifies SHA-1 before creating any game data, uses the ROM during import, then releases it from memory — it is never copied into the cache.

steps: Run the launcher for your platform.
On first boot, pick your legally obtained .gb / .gbc file or drop it onto the window.
Import takes a few seconds, then the game starts automatically.
Later launches load the generated cache and never ask for the ROM again.

apps.title: Generation 3 — Emerald: Evolved Starters
apps.summary: The original work in this repository: an Emerald ROM hack that extends the three Kanto starter lines with the official Pokémon Evolved expansion data plus our own DIY alternate branches. It builds a real .gba from the decompiled source at the repo root.

rom.note: Building links against a legally obtained US Emerald ROM. No ROM is distributed here.

steps: python3 tools/bootstrap_evolved_starters.py — apply starter species + evolution patches.
cd tools && npm install canvas && node generate_sprites.mjs — optional DIY sprites.
make tools -j$(nproc) then make -j$(nproc) — needs devkitARM + libpng.

apps.title: Future generations & the Emerald recomp
apps.summary: Where the next engines slot in. gen1recomp is vendored not just to be playable, but as a working reference for giving Emerald the same treatment — a native engine that reads a user-supplied ROM instead of patching one.

roadmap.title: Emerald, recomp-style
roadmap.detail: Apply gen1recomp's architecture to Gen 3: verify a user-supplied Emerald ROM by SHA-1, decode data and graphics into a cache, and drive it from a hand-written engine. The Evolved starter lines then become engine data rather than ROM patches — editable without a rebuild.
roadmap.reference: engines/gen1recomp/src/import — the ROM import and decode pipeline to model this on.

roadmap.title: Generation 2 — Gold / Silver / Crystal
roadmap.detail: The nearest neighbour to the Gen 1 engine; much of the map, battle and save handling in engines/gen1recomp/src generalises to the Gen 2 formats.
roadmap.reference: Register it in apps/hub/engines.json and it appears as a tab automatically.

roadmap.title: Evolved species beyond the starters
roadmap.detail: hack/species.json currently covers the three Kanto starter lines in both the official Evolved and DIY branches. It is the single source of truth for the Species tab and is designed to grow to the full roster.

roadmap.title: Shared asset pipeline
roadmap.detail: One sprite and species pipeline feeding every engine, so a species defined once renders in the Gen 1 engine, the Emerald build, and the hub.
